text: In pleasures, the fear of disease; in family, the fear of decline; in wealth, the fear of the king; in pride, the fear of despair; in strength, the fear of enemies; in beauty, the fear of old age; in learning, the fear of disputants; in qualities, the fear of the wicked; in the body, the fear of death. All things in this world are fraught with fear; for humans, only dispassion is fearlessness.
